_note: Local parameters of the transport subsystem (D7, 2026-11-09). Namespace 'trn' so the keys never collide with redesign/params/params.json. Read by fusion/transport.py (ctx.local) and team/D7/transport_calc.py (proofkit P:trn.*). Frame: aircraft frame (x aft, y right, z up), aircraft upright in cruise attitude in the box, props off, pitot boom out, pack out.

external_m.note: D-134 (S4, CDR-24, 2026-11-13): W 0.55 -> 0.56 m. The +10 mm the CDR asks for (CDR-BT-18 '1.26 x 0.55 x 0.54', 'box needs +10 mm inside length') goes on the axis the pod-nose stack runs along, which is x = this key's W: nose gap 2.95 -> 12.95 mm (>= 10), antenna tube B to pad -7.05 -> +2.95 mm (>= 2). Adding it to L (span) would not move either claim. The x-stop is the 15 mm LE lip of each cradle saddle (trn.cradle.saddle_x_m[0] = -0.015): the aircraft is loaded against the lips, so the stack is fixed. Longest side stays 1.25 m (car check against 1.28 m unchanged). Was [1.25, 0.55, 0.54]. L (y) x W (x) x H (z). Length and width are A1's D-16 values; height 0.54 (was 0.50) because the lower tube ends need free travel equal to the cradle crush stroke (CL-D7-BOX-H-REQ). Freeze only after CAR-FIT.md has two measured cars

shell_t_m.note: 4 mm corrugated polypropylene (Coroplast) twin-wall, one sheet per face, scored and folded

floor_doubler_t_m.note: no doubler: peak column pressure in the drop is 9.6 x 10 N / 3 000 mm2 = 32 kPa on a floor backed by the ground; dropped to save 0.12 kg for the 6 kg limit. Floor stack = 4 mm shell

lid_lining_t_m.note: D-31 round 2: no full lid lining (was 6 mm PE). It only protected the upper tube ends and foot pads, and the hold-down pillars stop the rebound well before they reach the lid (ASM-D7-REBOUND). Lid stack = 4 mm shell; +6 mm drop travel

lid_lip_m.note: plug lid: 30 mm lip folded down inside the base walls

flap_frac.note: glue flaps and folded corners, fraction of the shell area

top_gap_min_m.note: upper tube ends / upper foot pads to the bare lid shell, static

end_pad_t_m.note: PE pad on each end wall facing a wingtip (tip foam may touch a pad, fins and tubes never)

end_pad_size_m.note: x by z, centred on the wing chord at the tip

strap_y_m.note: +/-; two cam-buckle straps around the outside of the box, outboard of the cradles

fallback_height_m.note: height of the fallback box if a measured car rejects 0.54 m (CAR-FIT.md); the box then carries a MAX DROP 0.15 m label

fallback_label_drop_m.note: drop height printed on the fallback 0.50 m box; must stay <= CL-D7-FALLBACK-DROP-ALLOW

aft_gap_m.note: round 3 (C1 CR-C1-22): the aircraft sits 12 mm off the aft wall (foot pads, x 0.368) instead of centred; the four crushable feet take an aft-wall-first drop along their own stroke axis (CALC-D7-OFFAXIS). The slack moves to the nose side

nose_pad_t_m.note: round 4 (D-47/D-53 forward): 3/4 in PE plank on the front wall facing the pod nose (was 1 in). With the nose at -0.130 (envelope x 0.498) the 1 in pad left 6.6 mm < 10 mm; 3/4 in leaves 12.95 mm (CL-D7-NOSE-GAP). Box W stays 0.55 (A1 D-16). Costs nose-first drop height 0.079 -> 0.059 m (label-and-test case, KEEP UPRIGHT)

nose_pad_size_m.note: y by z, centred on the pod nose (y 0, z +0.05); 0.2 m tall so the nose still faces it after the 72 mm floor-drop sink. Round 4: antenna tube B ends <= 10 mm ahead of the nose (CR-D7-13) and so stops 2.9 mm short of the pad (CL-D7-ANTENNA-PAD-GAP); a 12 mm wide vertical relief slot (antenna z +6 mm down 90 mm, covers the 72 mm sink) is kept as margin

value: KEEP FLAT: NEVER STAND ON END
AIRCRAFT INSIDE: NO LOAD ON LID
PACKS TRAVEL IN THE BATTERY CAN, NEVER IN THE BOX
PROPS AND PITOT IN THE TRAY
labels.note: lid and both end walls; the end-first and lid-down drops are label-and-test only (CL-D7-END-DROP-ALLOW, CL-D7-LID-DROP-ALLOW)

antenna_ext_max_m.note: antenna tube B may end at most 10 mm ahead of the pod nose (D2/F3 accepted under D-47 forward); not in the props-off envelope

y_m.note: +/-; C1's assumed station kept: inboard of the fins (0.32), outboard of the pod (0.05), on the spar (spans -0.50..0.50)

saddle_x_m.note: from a 15 mm LE lip to 15 mm ahead of the elevon hinge (0.2496): elevons never pressed

cap_t_m.note: 6 mm PE cap on the saddle contour (no point load on the tape skin)

crush_t_m.note: PE plank 2 + 2 + 1 in laminated (127 mm) and band-sawn to 120 mm: >= t_req (CALC-D7-STROKE) for the 0.3 m drop, and bottoms (0.6 x 120 = 72 mm) >= 10 mm above the floor under the lower tube ends in the 0.54 m box (window 109-123 mm at n_allow 11.0)

crush_footprint_m.note: x by y per cradle, centred under the spar (x 0.08), y 0.175-0.225; static stress ~3.3 kPa (0.5 psi), confirm the density with T-D7-CUSHION

crush_x_m.note: column centred under the spar line

brace_anchor_y_in_m.note: inboard edge of the fin brace anchors on the spar (D3: y +/-(0.234-0.250)); cradles and pillars stay inboard of it, never press it. Copy of a D3 number: A1 to add it to params.json (CR-D7-08)

pad_min_m.note: C2: foam pad >= 40 x 40 mm (CL-C2-CRADLE-AREA 1 080 mm2) under the spar line; smallest side of the saddle contact and of the pillar face

relief_x_m.note: 9 mm relief channel across the saddle top, centred on the ESC-lead groove in the lower surface (harness leg x 0.0593-0.0643, recessed 0.5 mm): the saddle never bears on the taped leads. Copy of an F2 station: re-check if the harness route moves

relief_depth_m.note: channel depth below the lower-surface contour (cut with the knife after hot-wiring)

saddle_preload_m.note: round 4: the saddle is cut to the OUTER face of the tape skin WNG-003 (core lower surface less wing skin.model_t_m) and carries no preload: the aircraft rests on it by its weight (static 3.3 kPa on the column, CL-D7-CRADLE-STRESS). Hold-down comes only from the lid pillars (trn.holddown.preload_m 5 mm). E-TRN-06/07 list WNG-003 in also_contacts (CR-D7-19)

pe_density_kgm3.note: 1.7 lb/ft3 closed-cell polyethylene plank; weigh a plank

eps_use.note: usable crush strain before the steep rise; T-D7-CUSHION

eps_bottom.note: densification (bottoming) strain; sets the free travel under the lower tube ends

static_stress_band_kpa.note: static-loading band where 1.7-2.2 pcf PE cushion curves are near their minimum (0.3-1.0 psi); supplier curve or T-D7-CUSHION

travel_margin_m.note: free travel left under the lower tube ends when the column bottoms

size_m.note: x by y by z, on the floor between the cradles; 8 prop slots (4 flight + 4 spare) 285 x 30 x 40 mm on edge (8 x 30 + 9 x 8 = 312 mm along x); the last 150 mm along x holds the pitot-boom slot 220 x 25 x 25 mm (along y) with a 30 mm PE plug at the tip end and the field-pouch pocket 140 x 100 x 45 mm. Round 3: the landing spares (C5 CR-C5-06, 16 + 16 cartridges, 8 inserts, 2 shoes, about 0.75 L) do not fit a 0.54 L tray pocket and travel in the field tote (trn.field_bag)

solid_frac.note: XPS left after cutting slots and pockets

coroplast_areal_kgm2.note: 4.99 lb packaged weight of one 48 x 96 in 4 mm sheet (upper bound); weigh one sheet

handle_kg.note: EST, bought strap handle with 2 x M3x16 SHCS, M3 x 12 mm fender washers and nylocs (C6 CR-C6-08); 3 fitted

cam_strap_kg.note: EST, 25 mm PP webbing 1.8 m + cam buckle; 2 fitted

consumables_kg.note: EST, LSE tape, hot-melt, zip ties, M3 handle hardware

pouch_kg.note: EST, field pouch: 10 mm prop spanner (D-40, the one allowed tool), 4 spare M6 prop nuts, 2.5 mm hex key, tape, laminated checklist

handle_backing_kg.note: EST, 3 mm laser-cut plywood strip 140 x 30 mm inside the wall behind each handle (600 kg/m3 -> 7.6 g): spreads the M3 nut load over 4 200 mm2 of Coroplast instead of a 12 mm washer

value: open box: 2 cam straps, lift lid (pillars come with it); unfold the mat upwind, rubber up
lift aircraft by the centre section, stand it on its four feet on the mat; glance at the four replace-mark grooves
take props, pitot boom and pouch from the tray
fit 4 props, colour-matched to the motor (LH nut on the CW motors), 10 mm spanner
plug in the pitot boom, check the tubes, tip cover off
TX on (before the pack, flight card)
take a pack from the battery can, seat it at the trim mark, strap it
close the AS150U pack plug, FC boots
setup_steps_s.note: time from the closed box to the start of the arm check (R-FIELD-SETUP). Round 3: mat unfold (C5 S1), foot groove glance (C5 S7) and TX-on-first (F5 CR-F5-09) added, +25 s. T-D7-SETUP replaces these

size_m.note: x by y footprint of each lid hold-down pillar, centred over the spar (x 0.08) at y +/-0.20 (y 0.17-0.23, inboard of the brace anchors at 0.234), directly above the cradle; taped to the bare lid shell

preload_m.note: pillar is cut 5 mm longer than the gap; 10 mm soft PE face on the wing side

xps_bearing_kpa.note: XPS F-250 compressive strength C2 uses for the cradle patch (86 N x 1.5 over 1 080 mm2); the same skin over the spar carries the pillar

bearing_sf.note: ultimate factor C2 applies to the patch bearing

trn._note_r2: D7 round 2 (2026-11-09, CR-A1-35 / D-31): column 127 -> 120 mm so it cannot bottom within 10 mm of the floor in the 0.54 m box (envelope grew to 0.438 m); lid lining dropped (the pillars arrest the rebound, ASM-D7-REBOUND), +6 mm travel; M3 handles with plywood backing strips (C6 CR-C6-08); cradle pad and brace gap checked (C2 CR-C2-05, D3 CR-D3-11)

field_bag._note: Second and third carried items (round 3). Item 2 is the battery can (GND-004 ammo can, E2) with both packs in their LiPo bags (GND-003). Item 3 is the folded landing mat (TRN-104, C5 spec) with the field tote (TRN-107: TX, landing spares, flight card). Packs never in the box (ASM-D7-PACK-OUT); the mat is too heavy for the box under the 6 kg limit.

mat_size_m.note: C5 stance rule S1: >= 0.8 x 0.8 m, rubber on ply; two 0.8 x 0.4 m panels hinged with cloth tape, folds to 0.8 x 0.4 m

mat_ply_kgm2.note: 3 mm birch ply at 680 kg/m3 (laser-cut stock); weigh

mat_rubber_kgm2.note: 1.5 mm SBR/neoprene sheet at 1 400 kg/m3; C5 to confirm 1.5 mm keeps mu 0.7

lipo_bag_kg.note: EST, fire-resistant LiPo bag sized for two 4S packs (E2)

landing_spares_kg.note: GER-005 x4 4.42 g + GER-009 x4 4.34 g + GER-010 x16 0.62 g + GER-011 x16 0.53 g + GER-012 x2 5.42 g = 64 g (D5 EST), in a 1 L food box in the tote

tote_kg.note: EST, soft tote about 0.45 x 0.35 x 0.25 m

tx_kg.note: EST, RadioMaster Pocket with two 18650 cells (GND-001, F5); weigh it

can_kg.note: EST, Harbor Freight 63750 .50 cal ammo can (GND-004, E2), seal vented; weigh it

mat_hinge_kg.note: EST, cloth-tape hinge, edge tape and a webbing carry loop

offaxis._note: Off-axis impacts (C1 CR-C1-22). Floor drop is the design case (CALC-D7-STROKE). The others are checked for the drop height the current stack allows; nothing here grows the box.

foot_stroke_m.note: usable crush of one pre-crushed foot cartridge (42 mm, 2 mm pre-crush; C5 R3 table); T-C5-FOOT-RIG

blade_half_t_m.note: half the out-of-plane thickness of an APC 11 x 5.5MR at the hub (prop on, clocked spanwise; option CR-D7-15); measure a prop

trn._note_r3: D7 round 3 (2026-11-09): off-axis drops (C1 CR-C1-22): aircraft 12 mm off the aft wall so the feet take an aft-wall drop, 1 in PE nose pad, labels for end-first and lid-down; strap ids L/R (A4 CR-A4-24); stowed prop edges; landing spares and mat in the field tote (C5 CR-C5-06, I1 CR-I1-18); set-up steps +25 s

handle._note: Round 4 (A4 PLAN-STATUS, C6 joint_stacks.json E-TRN-13...15, D-41): grip stack of each M3 handle bolt. Engagement = bolt length - grip, measured from the nut bearing face; must be >= nyloc height + requirements.nyloc_pitches_min x pitch (5.0 mm, C6 min_engagement_mm). CALC-D7-HANDLE-GRIP

strap_t_m.note: EST, thickness of the bought strap handle's end tab under the washer; measure with calipers on receipt. Max allowed 3.0 mm with M3x16 (CL-D7-HANDLE-STRAP-T-MAX); thicker -> buy M3x20 (protrudes 9 mm inside, clear of the pads)

washer_t_m.note: M3 x 12 mm fender washer outside

backing_t_m.note: 3 mm birch ply backing strip inside the wall

trn._note_r4: D7 round 4 (2026-11-10): saddle modelled at contact with the outer skin face, preload 0 (CR-A4-46); handle grip stack and engagement >= 5.0 mm (D-41, C6 E-TRN-13...15); C6 ground_joint / joint_stack blocks copied into E-TRN-13...15
